what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Afghanistan, counted by IDMC and UNHCR side by side.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 4355147 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence, and UNHCR counted 3199023.
Many Afghans also live abroad, mainly in Pakistan and Iran.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan in every year from 2003 to 2025, with the Taleban, Hizb-i Islami-yi Afghanistan, NRF and AFF among the government's opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2025, and an interstate armed conflict between Afghanistan and Pakistan in 2024 and 2025.

when.text: IDMC's figure rose from 297000 in 2009 to a peak of 4513270 in 2022.
New conflict displacements were highest in 2021, and new disaster displacements in 2024, in IDMC's records.

how.text: In 2025 IDMC counts 1156124 more internally displaced people than UNHCR; the figures are never added together.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
